text:
Let me be born again,

never again in a foreign land,

but in the midst of my people,

with my sky, my mountain,

with my sea and my family.

And may there remain in my memory

this life so alive,

and may I be able to tell my story

as beggar and captive,

and my sighs of exile.

Because there is sweetness and beauty

in bitterness passed through,

I want the memory lit

after the anguish has gone out.

With what tenderness I look at myself!

A sailor returned

with his ship anchored at the bottom,

sometimes

I almost forget this world was true,

(Or perhaps it was false).

translation.title: Desire to Return
translation.editorial_note: The translation keeps the exile's wish for rebirth among her own people and the uncertain truth of the remembered world.
